title: 第851章 灵酒之争十第850章 灵酒之争九
lines: 殿中不少见多识广的修士目光一凝，低声交谈之声接连响起，很快便有人识出了此人的身份来历。
“瀚古州的穆苍，竟然是他！”
“瀚古州可是不输给大渊州的超级大州，疆域广袤、传承深远，底蕴远超云荒、赤凰之流，但以往万象酒会可从未有瀚古州修士踏足，没想到今日竟会现身在此。”
“穆苍虽已年近三百，早就不在年轻天骄之列，可论实战底蕴，即便放在瀚古州本土，能稳胜他的人也是屈指可数。”
“当年黑风古域妖祸作乱，瀚古州修士死伤无数，是他独身闯入万妖巢穴，连斩三头元婴后期妖王，成为了平定那场祸患的最大功臣。”
“还有三州交界的遗迹战争，他一人独挡外州七大宗门联手，硬生生护住瀚古州传承至宝全身而退，他那些事迹，哪一桩不是震动州域的大事？”
场中邹衍在听闻对方名号后，面色明显沉了几分。
若换作其它场合，他绝不愿与这等人物交手。
可星河溯元酿近在眼前，此酒能抹平他多年道基暗伤，乃是他突破元婴的关键所在。
他不愿就此退让，当即拱手沉声开口：
“原来是瀚古州穆前辈，晚辈邹衍，还请前辈手下留情。”
话音刚落，邹衍不再迟疑，体内灵力尽数奔涌而出，裂神术瞬间催动，一道道凌厉到近乎撕扯空气的裂神光刃自他掌心射出。
他身为赤凰州问道会第三，一身杀伐神通早已打磨得极为纯熟，此刻全力出手，漫天光刃交错纵横，几乎封死了穆苍所有闪避方位，攻势铺天盖地，不留半分空隙。
全场修士目光紧锁，不少人暗自评估——邹衍这一手裂神术确实十分强力，若在场上的是他们自己，定然抵挡不住。
可穆苍立在原地，神色淡然如水，双脚分毫未动，只是随意抬手一拂，一层厚重凝实的灵力屏障瞬间自周身铺开，将整个人牢牢护在其中。
漫天裂神光刃撞上那层屏障时，预想中的爆裂声并未出现——
那些足以重创结丹乃至元婴修士的锋锐刃光，落在屏障表面后，仅仅漾开一圈圈浅淡的涟漪，转瞬便消融无踪，连一丝灵力余波都无法穿透分毫。
邹衍瞳孔骤缩，心头大震，当即不敢再有半分藏拙，指尖飞速掐动繁复印诀。
掌心灵力凝聚，一柄锋芒逼人的法宝长枪成型，他身形骤然一闪，直奔穆苍近身刺去，打算依靠贴身强攻撕开对方防御。
穆苍淡淡摇头，脚步轻轻一抬，恰好预判出邹衍全部走位轨迹。
枯瘦的手掌平平横推而出，没有任何花哨繁复的术法，只有纯粹凝练到极致的本源灵力，精准拍在长枪枪尖之上。
的一声闷响。
邹衍倾尽全力的法宝长枪当场脱手飞射而出，狂暴的反震之力更是直冲他四肢经脉。
邹衍体内气血剧烈翻腾，身形不受控制地连连后退，喉头涌上一股腥甜。
content_en:
Many well-informed monks in the hall focused their gazes, and whispers of conversation rang out one after another. Soon someone recognized this person's identity.
"Mu Cang from Hangu Province is actually him!"
"Hangu Prefecture is a super-large state that is not inferior to Dayuan Prefecture. It has a vast territory and profound inheritance. Its foundation far exceeds that of Yunhuang and Chihuang. However, no monks from Hangu Prefecture have ever set foot on the Wanxiang Reception Party in the past. I didn't expect that they would appear here today."
"Although Mu Cang is nearly three hundred years old, he has long been no longer among the young geniuses. But in terms of actual combat experience, even in Hangu Province, there are only a handful of people who can defeat him."
"Back then, the Black Wind Ancient Territory was in turmoil caused by demons, and monks in Hangu State suffered numerous casualties. It was he who broke into the Ten Thousand Demons' Lair alone and beheaded three late-stage Nascent Soul demon kings, becoming the biggest contributor to putting down that disaster."
"There is also the relics war at the junction of the three states. He single-handedly blocked the seven major sects from other states who joined forces to protect the Hangu state's inherited treasure and escaped unscathed. Which of his deeds is not a major event that shocked the state?"
Zou Yan's expression became visibly darker after hearing the opponent's name.
On any other occasion, he would never want to fight against such a person.
But the Xinghe Tu Yuan Brew is right in front of him. This wine can erase the hidden wounds of his Daoji for many years, which is the key to his breakthrough to Yuanying.
Unwilling to give in, he immediately handed over his hands and spoke in a deep voice:
"It turns out to be Senior Mu from Hanguzhou, and junior Zou Yan. Please show mercy to me, senior."
As soon as he finished speaking, Zou Yan no longer hesitated, all the spiritual energy in his body surged out, and the God-Splitting Technique was activated instantly, and a series of God-Splitting Light Blades that were so sharp that they almost ripped the air were shot out from his palms.
As the third member of the Red Phoenix Prefecture Dao Association, he had already perfected his killing powers. At this moment, he launched his attack with all his strength. The light blades crisscrossed the sky, almost blocking all Mu Cang's dodge directions. The attack was overwhelming, leaving no gaps.
The eyes of all the monks in the audience were locked, and many people secretly assessed that Zou Yan's divine splitting technique was indeed very powerful. If they were the ones on the field, they would definitely not be able to resist it.
But Mu Cang stood there, his expression as calm as water, his feet did not move at all, he just raised his hand and flicked it casually, and a thick and solid spiritual barrier instantly spread out around him, firmly protecting his whole body.
When the God-Splitting Light Blade hit the barrier, the expected explosion did not appear——
Those sharp blades of light that were enough to seriously injure Danjie and even Nascent Soul cultivators fell behind the surface of the barrier, only causing shallow ripples, and then disappeared without a trace in an instant. Not even a trace of spiritual power could penetrate it.
Zou Yan's pupils shrank suddenly, and his heart was shocked. He immediately did not dare to hide his clumsiness any more, and quickly performed the complex copying technique with his fingertips.
Condensing his spiritual energy in his palm, a sharp magical spear took shape. He suddenly flashed forward and stabbed Mu Cang at close range, intending to tear apart the opponent's defense with a close attack.
Mu Cang shook his head lightly and raised his steps slightly, predicting all of Zou Yan's movements.
The skinny palm was pushed out flatly, without any fancy and complicated techniques, only the pure and extremely condensed original spiritual power, which was accurately shot on the tip of the spear.
"Bang"
A muffled sound.
Zou Yan put all his strength into the magic weapon spear and flew out on the spot, and the violent counterattack force went straight to the meridians of his limbs.
The energy and blood in Zou Yan's body surged violently, and he retreated uncontrollably, with a fishy-sweet feeling in his throat.
